title: Yellow Molten German Cheese Quesadilla
description: A sour, molten, festive German dish featuring shredded Mexican cheese, served on a talavera plate and made using a bain-marie for a dairy-free-friendly option.

ingredients.name: shredded Mexican cheese
ingredients.notes: such as Oaxaca or Monterey Jack

instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
In a bowl, mix together the shredded cheese, German mustard, sour cream, and yellow food coloring until well combined.
Place a tortilla in the skillet and sprinkle a quarter of the cheese mixture onto half of the tortilla.
Fold the tortilla in half to enclose the cheese mixture.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the tortilla is lightly browned and the cheese is melted.
Flip the quesadilla and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until the other side is also lightly browned.
Repeat with the remaining tortillas and cheese mixture.
Serve the quesadillas on a talavera plate and top with chopped fresh cilantro and a squeeze of lemon juice.
Place the plate over a bain-marie to keep the cheese molten and serve immediately.
